text:
ana: Quick sync: we need a compact migration appendix for v1->v2 focused on three user pain points: param rename, embed dim mismatches, and streaming callback changes. Goal: one-page checklist per SDK (js/py/ios).

ben: I'll draft the JS/TS checklist. Plan to include a small snippet showing the param rename and the shim toggle.

marta: I'll cover Python and add the embed-dim detection pattern. Suggest adding a short snippet that retries with a compatible model id if dims mismatch.

ana (typo correction): sorry, meant ana.

docs-bot: Heads up: editorial freeze starts 48h before sunset email. See /ops/comm.

ana: noted. Also, can we add a single `migration-summary.md` that teams can link to from SDK CHANGELOGs? Keep it concise (<300 words).

ben: draft snippet for rename/shim: ```js
// old v1 call
client.generate({ model_id: "rwd-small-001", prompt: "hi" })

// new v2 call
client.generate({ model: "rwd-small-001", input: "hi" })

// runtime shim (docs example)
const client = new Redwood({ featureFlags: ["docs.v1_compat_shim"] })
```

marta: Python embed fallback example: ```py
vec = embed_api.get("/v2/embeddings", input=...)
if len(vec) != expected_dim:
    # fallback: re-embed with compatible model
    vec = embed_api.get("/v2/embeddings", model="rwd-compat-001", input=...)
```

docs-bot: Reminder: add `docs/compat` label to each PR. Automation will copy snippet files to /legacy for archival.

tom: Mobile note: swapping to a higher-dim embedding increased cold-start latency ~120ms on device A. Adding a "performance impact" note under mobile/quickstart and a short mitigation: prewarm embeddings on app startup.

marta: We should also warn that the shim translates names but not semantics. Example: `top_k` behavior changed in v2; shim won't rewrite logic. Add to migration guide.

sdk-eng: Confirmed. The shim maps payload keys but we purposely avoid behavioral polyfills. We'll add a clear warning header to the shim docs: "translates parameters only, not runtime semantics."

ben: Where should the one-page summary live? Suggest `/docs/migration/one-pager.md` and then add links from SDK repos.

ana: Agree. I'll create the one-pager and a short bullet list: "What changed", "Quick fixes", "Where to find legacy snippets". Keep it copy-light.

qa-bot: Checklist created: [ ] migration-one-pager added, [ ] JS snippets updated, [ ] Py snippets updated, [ ] mobile note added, [ ] preview build green.

marta: I'm adding a small unit test snippet to the Python examples repo to assert embed dim matches expected for downstream pipelines.

ben: Also adding a streaming diff note: new callback signature returns { event, chunk } instead of raw string. Will include both before/after snippets with small migration diff.

ana: Can we include a tiny troubleshooting section for customers who see 422 on embeddings after swap? Suggest steps: 1) check embed_dim, 2) try compat model id, 3) open support ticket with sample vector.

mobile-eng: I'll add the prewarm code snippet for iOS quickstart and note the additional memory consideration.

docs-bot: Please tag PRs with `preview/ready` to trigger staging deployment. Editorial will do a quick pass after preview build completes.

ben: I'll open PRs for docs and snippets today. Tagging `docs/compat` and `impact/medium`.

marta: Opening Python PR now. Adding smoke tests in PR description.

qa-bot: Preview builds queued. Expect ~12 min.

(brief pause)

qa-bot: Preview build successful for both PRs. Running smoke tests...

qa-bot: Smoke results: JS streaming example failing (callback shape mismatch). Marked `impact/high`. All embed-dim tests pass.

ben: On the streaming fail. I'll push a tiny patch to the TS snippet to match new signature.

marta: Python PR merged, legacy snippets moved to /legacy, and banner added to top of legacy pages: "Deprecated - migrate to v2."

ana: One-pager drafted and linked in PR description. cc @support to prepare canned responses for customers hitting dim mismatch.

mobile-eng: Mobile quickstart updated and merged. Added note and example prewarm call.

ben: Streaming fix pushed and preview re-run. QA green now.

ana: Great work. I'll squash meta PR into final merge and coordinate the deprecation notice timing with comms.

docs-bot: Final reminder: schedule deprecation email 72 hours before sunset; ensure support/cs have the migration one-pager link.

ana: Done. Closing this thread. Thanks everyone! :tada:
